paragraphs.text: Northgate Bike Workshop runs free repair sessions every Thursday evening from 6 pm to 8 pm in the community centre car park. Volunteers will show you how to fix your own bike.
Common problems such as flat tyres, loose brakes and noisy chains can usually be solved in one session. For larger repairs, you may need to buy parts, which are sold at cost price.
Please bring your bike clean, as dirty bikes are harder to work on. Tools and gloves are provided. If you only need a quick check, please arrive at least ten minutes before the session ends.
Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult. Sessions are cancelled in heavy rain, and updates are posted on the workshop’s social media page.
The workshop also sells second-hand bikes that have been repaired by volunteers. All the money raised is used to buy new tools and spare parts for future sessions.
The Harbour Museum welcomes school groups from Tuesday to Friday. Visits must be booked at least four weeks in advance by email.
Each visit lasts two hours and includes a guided tour and a hands-on activity, such as making a model boat. Groups are usually split into two smaller teams for the activity.
There is one free adult place for every eight pupils. Additional adults pay £4 each.
Groups can eat packed lunches in the education room, which seats up to 35 people. Please tell us when booking if any pupils use a wheelchair. Lockers are available for coats and bags.
The museum shop is open during visits, but pupils should only visit it with an adult. Photographs may be taken anywhere in the museum except in the special exhibition room.
After the visit, teachers receive a set of classroom activities by email to help pupils review what they have learned.

items.quote: runs free repair sessions every Thursday evening
items.prompt: On which evening are the repair sessions held?

explanation.en: “every Thursday evening from 6 pm to 8 pm” → Thursday. The question asks for the day, not the time.
explanation.kk: «every Thursday evening from 6 pm to 8 pm» → Thursday. Уақыт емес, күн сұралады.
explanation.ru: «every Thursday evening from 6 pm to 8 pm» → Thursday. Спрашивают день, а не время.

items.quote: Volunteers will show you how to fix your own bike
items.prompt: Who shows people how to fix their bikes?

explanation.en: “Volunteers will show you how to fix your own bike” → volunteers, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «Volunteers will show you how to fix your own bike» → volunteers, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «Volunteers will show you how to fix your own bike» → volunteers, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

items.quote: which are sold at cost price
items.prompt: At what price are bike parts sold?

explanation.en: “you may need to buy parts, which are sold at cost price” → cost price. The sessions are free, but parts are not.
explanation.kk: «you may need to buy parts, which are sold at cost price» → cost price. Сабақ тегін, ал бөлшектер тегін емес.
explanation.ru: «you may need to buy parts, which are sold at cost price» → cost price. Сами занятия бесплатные, но детали — нет.

items.prompt: Apart from tools, what is provided at the sessions?

explanation.en: “Tools and gloves are provided” → gloves. You bring your own bike — it is not provided.
explanation.kk: «Tools and gloves are provided» → gloves. Велосипедті өзіңіз әкелесіз — ол берілмейді.
explanation.ru: «Tools and gloves are provided» → gloves. Велосипед приносят свой — его не выдают.

items.quote: updates are posted on the workshop’s social media page
items.prompt: On what kind of page are updates about cancelled sessions posted?

explanation.en: “on the workshop’s social media page” → social media. “Page” is in the question, and “social media page” is three words.
explanation.kk: «on the workshop’s social media page» → social media. «Page» сұрақта тұр, «social media page» — үш сөз.
explanation.ru: «on the workshop’s social media page» → social media. «Page» уже в вопросе, «social media page» — три слова.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Read Text A. Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

items.quote: Visits must be booked at least four weeks in advance by email
items.prompt: How must school visits be booked?

explanation.en: “booked at least four weeks in advance by email” → by email. “How” asks for the method, not the “four weeks”.
explanation.kk: «booked at least four weeks in advance by email» → by email. «How» — мерзім (four weeks) емес, тәсіл.
explanation.ru: «booked at least four weeks in advance by email» → by email. «How» — способ, а не срок «four weeks».

items.prompt: How long does each visit last?

explanation.en: “Each visit lasts two hours” → two hours. “Four weeks” is the booking deadline.
explanation.kk: «Each visit lasts two hours» → two hours. «Four weeks» — брондау мерзімі.
explanation.ru: «Each visit lasts two hours» → two hours. «Four weeks» — срок бронирования.

items.quote: There is one free adult place for every eight pupils
items.prompt: How many pupils are there for each free adult place?

explanation.en: “one free adult place for every eight pupils” → eight (or 8). £4 is what an extra adult pays.
explanation.kk: «one free adult place for every eight pupils» → eight (немесе 8). £4 — қосымша ересектің ақысы.
explanation.ru: «one free adult place for every eight pupils» → eight (или 8). £4 — плата за дополнительного взрослого.

items.prompt: How much does each additional adult pay?

explanation.en: “Additional adults pay £4 each” → £4 (the sign is optional).
explanation.kk: «Additional adults pay £4 each» → £4 (белгісіз де болады) — әр қосымша ересектің ақысы.

items.quote: the education room, which seats up to 35 people
items.prompt: How many people can the education room seat?

explanation.en: “which seats up to 35 people” → 35. “People” is already in the question.
explanation.kk: «which seats up to 35 people» → 35. «People» сөзі сұрақта тұр.
explanation.ru: «which seats up to 35 people» → 35. Слово «people» уже в вопросе.
